item.title: INEC Stresses Voter Safety as Key to Credible Elections in Upcoming Polls
item.description: The Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) has emphasized that credible elections depend on citizens feeling secure enough to participate without fear.INEC Chairman, Professor Joash Ojo Amupitan, SAN, made this declaration during a high-level meeting with security agencies in Abuja. item.title: Police arrest landlady over poisoning of tenant’s three-year-old child
item.description: The Ondo State Police Command has arrested a woman, Nafisat Lateef, for allegedly poisoning a three-year-old boy at Omifon community in Odigbo Local Government Area.The state Police Public Relations Officer, DSP Abayomi Jimoh, disclosed the arrest in a statement on Friday, noting that the victim is the child of her tenant.According to Jimoh, the 40-year-old suspect allegedly committed the offence on Tuesday following an argument with the victim’s mother, identified as Rofiat. item.title: Su!cide bomb blast at Pakistan mosque kills at least 31, injures 169
item.description: A suicide blast at a Shiite mosque in Islamabad killed at least 31 people on Friday, with 169 more wounded in the deadliest attack in Pakistan’s capital since the 2008 Marriott hotel bombing.City officials said 31 people died in the blast at the Imam Bargah Qasr-e-Khadijatul Kubra mosque in the Tarlai area on the city’s outskirts, with scores more being treated for injuries. item.title: Kabiru Turaki-led NWC rejects Wike faction’s moves to take over PDP headquarters
item.description: The national working committee (NWC) of the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP), led by Kabiru Turaki, has vowed to resist the planned takeover of the party’s headquarters in Abuja by a faction backed by Nyesom Wike, the minister of the Federal Capital Territory (FCT).
